name: game-launcher
title: Game Launcher
description: Search and launch your installed games from Steam, Lutris and Heroic.
author: DavidSeptimus

commands.name: search-games
commands.title: Search Games
commands.subtitle: Game Launcher
commands.description: Search your installed games and launch them, most recently played first.

preferences.name: layout
preferences.title: Layout
preferences.description: Show games as an artwork grid or a list.

preferences.name: gridSize
preferences.title: Games per Row
preferences.description: How many games fit in a grid row. Auto picks a size that suits the artwork.

preferences.name: labels
preferences.title: Grid Labels
preferences.description: Text shown under each game in the grid.

preferences.name: downloadArtwork
preferences.title: Download High-Quality Artwork
preferences.label: Download High-Quality Artwork
preferences.description: Download higher-resolution covers, banners and icons where available, instead of the low-resolution copies launchers keep locally. Downloads are kept on disk.

preferences.name: hideDuplicates
preferences.title: Merge Duplicates
preferences.label: Merge Duplicates
preferences.description: Show a game installed in several launchers as one entry. Choose which launcher opens it with the Launcher Priority action.

preferences.name: steamPath
preferences.title: Steam Folder
preferences.description: Only use the Steam install in this folder. Leave empty to find it automatically.

preferences.name: includeNonGames
preferences.title: Show Steam Tools
preferences.label: Show Steam Tools
preferences.description: Also list Proton, the Steam Linux Runtime and other non-game Steam apps.

preferences.name: lutrisPath
preferences.title: Lutris Folder
preferences.description: Only use the Lutris data folder at this path (the one containing pga.db). Leave empty to find it automatically.

preferences.name: includeStoreClients
preferences.title: Show Lutris Store Clients
preferences.label: Show Lutris Store Clients
preferences.description: Also list the store apps Lutris installs to run games, such as the Epic Games Store and Battle.net.

preferences.name: heroicPath
preferences.title: Heroic Folder
preferences.description: Only use the Heroic config folder at this path (the one containing config.json). Leave empty to find it automatically.
